scope: axel_town native white mesh-only route; no full-game or texture acceptance
target_boundary: Human confirmed: map loading timing begins to the current demanded region fully ready, preserving the historical pipeline-to-full-ready boundary. Process startup remains a separate secondary metric.

target_boundary_confirmation.user_wording: 地图加载计时开始→当前需求区域完整就绪（沿用历史口径）
target_boundary_confirmation.texture_gate: unchanged; white-stage stability is still required before texture work

anchors.process_spawn: Owned Godot OS process creation timestamp with matching PID; not wrapper launch or script initialize.
anchors.pipeline_begin: report.begin_ticks_us, bridged to Unix only with report.cpu_time_anchor.
anchors.entry: begin + entry_ms. Mesh-only stream_chunk and entry batches ready, followed by frame_post_draw; not ordinary GameSession player-input handoff.
anchors.full_ready: begin + origin_first_ready.at_ms. Existing origin-focus demand/job/render-batch queues empty for three consecutive frames; not every distant map chunk resident.

missing_data: Unavailable anchors, durations, cache observations and work counters remain null. Never substitute zero, wrapper start or a different readiness condition.
process_clock_limit: Existing process-to-pipeline values use one OS Unix/game-ticks bridge. They are estimates with unmeasured clock error, not exact high-resolution startup spans.

cache_contract.native_products: required, retained; existing reports do not provide a complete native-product byte-SHA manifest
cache_contract.application_derived: dependency index rebuilt; cooked geometry, road arrays, prefab binary, collision products, prefab bounds and model metadata reuse disabled by recorded controls
cache_contract.in_process: fresh process, normal same-path sharing and deduplication remain enabled
cache_contract.driver_shader_cache: not reset or measured by these reports

white_contract.geometry_collision_navigation: Preserve production geometry, transforms, collision, navigation registration and batch identity; use the existing route validators.
white_contract.route: origin 8s, two steady windows 60s, native departure/unload/return, fixed reload 35s; source snapshot owns hard-coded route details
white_contract.unload_return: 63 terrain objects and 2151 largest-guild meshes retired and fully returned; same focus; six final cleanup counters zero

group_identity: actual dirty working-tree source path/SHA manifest
all recorded controls and candidate switches
cache flags and observed cache checks
PresentMon sidecar presence, executable SHA256, wrapper SHA256 and normalized capture arguments
actual WEOBS module state and graphics filters
grouping_limits: Missing essential identity isolates a run in its own group. Native-product byte inventory and hardware identity are unavailable in legacy inputs and remain explicit limitations, not inferred matches.

statistics.p50: median (mean of the two central values for even N)
statistics.p95: nearest-rank: sorted[ceil(0.95*N)-1]; at N=10 p95 equals max
statistics.max: maximum of all retained valid observations; no outlier deletion
statistics.insufficient: Every metric with fewer than 10 values is insufficient; diagnostic runs never establish a normal-performance target.
statistics.attempts: Keep failed and incomplete runs with reasons; do not silently replace failures until N passes.
statistics.frames: Separate phases and runs. Export per-run p50/p95/max and >33/50/100/200ms counts; do not pool phase FPS or remove observer-overlap frames.

normal_observers: No GDB, official profiler, heartbeat, method timing or native tracing. Existing quiet owned CPU sampler and one module observation remain explicitly identified.
diagnostic_observers: Different observer schemas, engines or caches form different groups; descriptive statistics only, no normal speedup claim. A present .presentmon_validation.json always declares a PresentMon diagnostic observer, even if the underlying map runner calls itself normal. Missing executable/wrapper identity remains null and isolates that run; missing or mismatched target PID and unsuccessful capture invalidate it. Session names, target PIDs and output paths are run-specific and do not split otherwise identical groups. PresentMon CPU/GPU timing categories are not OS thread CPU execution or a proved wait cause.
work_guardrails: Retain all 38 initial selected counters. Current accepted direct-prefab equations are avoided=417+direct, projection visited/freed=2204-direct (direct=742). Keep legacy mismatches visible. Future intentional work reductions need explicit tested equations, not removed counters.
